Definition: imperfect of G1510; I (thou, etc.) was (wast or were):--+ agree, be, X have (+ charge of), hold, use, was(-t), were.
BiblicalUsage: En is 'was' — the imperfect of 'to be.' In the beginning was the Word in John 1:1, and the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise in Matthew 1:18.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe 'was' at the start of John's gospel reaches back before time began, and the Word who was with God is the same Word who was born of Mary — eternity stepped into history.
